name: The Beach Club at The Boca Raton
positioning: Beach Club, the beachside hotel at The Boca Raton, with a private beach, three private pools and cabanas
best_for: Travelers who want a private beach and pools right outside their room
Suite guests who want butler service and access to a private 27th-floor lounge

facts.text: Beach Club is a beachside escape at The Boca Raton, designed to connect inside and out.
Suites come in one- and two-bedroom options with expansive outdoor spaces.
Beach Club suite guests are part of The Boca Raton Suite Collection, together with suite guests of Tower and Yacht Club.
Suite Collection benefits include priority dining reservations, VIP check-in, and priority pool and beach seating.
Suite Collection guests have a dedicated floor butler team.
Suite Collection guests have exclusive access to curated experiences such as Monkey Sunday Brunch, mid-day Discover Cruises and a curated cocktail demo.
Top of the Tower was once home to Chef Gordon Ramsay's first North American outpost.
Marisol serves Mediterranean fare overlooking the ocean, in an indoor-outdoor setting with an expansive covered terrace.
Marisol's menu features fresh seafood delivered daily by local fishermen, with shellfish towers and raw bar options.

highlights.text: Beach Club has half a mile of private golden beach.
Beach Club has three private pools.
Rooms and suites are designed with honed marble and cerused woods, with vibrant coral velvet accents.
Rooms have natural textures, open light-filled spaces and floor-to-ceiling views of the ocean.

Beach Club Suite Collection guests get afternoon and evening access to Top of the Tower, a private 27th-floor lounge with sweeping views of the Atlantic Ocean and the South Florida coastline, with complimentary bites and drinks.

considerations.text: Onda, the sand-side restaurant, is seasonal: it opens each winter season.
Marisol's daytime dress code is Beach Elegant, with shirts, cover-ups and footwear required.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
